races.drawBiasExplanation: Strong low draw bias due to tight left-handed track

verdict.comment: Ante-post favourite EAST INDIA DOCK has deserved his place in the market. Next on the list are Zoffee and Who's Glen.

comments.bashfulboy: 4th and respectable 9th in last two editions of 2m2f Cesarewitch at Newmarket in October
comments.caballodemar: Spectacular improver on AW, upped to 2m last time; well handicapped with 3lb penalty
comments.chargingthunder: Doing well for new yard; there's a good chance this trip will suit if he adapts to Chester
comments.chemistry: Left Aidan O'Brien for 30,000gns; he gallops on as if he could be an out-and-out stayer
comments.dawnrising: Effective in top, big-field handicaps but wide draw may play against him
comments.divinecomedy: Fine record over the last two years; needs better still but respected on first run here
comments.dukeofoxford: Always behind in major races in his only three turf starts, 11th in this (12-1) last year
comments.eastindiadock: Progressive at up to 2m on the Flat last year and one of the top juvenile hurdlers since
comments.emiyn: Second in this last year (good to firm) and is 2lb lower today but slow starts are a worry
comments.hotfuss: Upped to 2m at Southwell (AW) in February for latest Flat run and won it in clearcut style
comments.leinster: 4 runs; 270 days off when making all in 18-runner Curragh handicap (1m4f, soft; favourite)
comments.liamswagger: Useful hurdler; never-nearer third at Chelmsford (1m6f, AW) was not backed up on Sunday
comments.morningair: 1-6 in France, the win over 1m2f on heavy as 2yo; won hurdle debut before two modest runs
comments.spiritmixer: No show from wide draw in this race last year but he returned to Chester for two 2m wins
comments.vaguelyroyal: Peak form gives him a shout but others are more persuasive; tongue tied first time
comments.whosglen: Won here (1m6f, heavy) last September; second at Kempton (upped to 2m, AW) six weeks ago
comments.zoffee: Nearly won this in 2023; did so in it last year (good to firm) off 1lb lower than today

races.raceComment: spiritmixer is marginally preferred with a score of 57.1%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more proven at trip and better suited by conditions over caballodemar. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Strong low draw bias due to tight left-handed track

verdict.comment: Having started a conspicuously big price on her reappearance, when running well nevertheless, WARDA JAMILA (nap) can step up today.

comments.andaleep: Unraced here; has a highly competitive mark if the two runs this spring have put him right
comments.auldtoonloon: Relished return to Flat for new yard last term; 2023 saw a win on only visit to this track
comments.flightleader: 4-10 in France for Andre Fabre; 100,000gns buy in October; gelded; looks on a testing mark
comments.greycuban: Won twice over C&D last July; much more to prove if the ground is good to firm
comments.letsdream: Lightly raced; needs to step up from 3yo runs and plenty to prove away from soft ground
comments.mustazeed: Unraced on firmer than good since 2021; Newbury suits him particularly well; unraced here
comments.penzance: Needs to be in peak form but he's never quite delivered that on turf and is 0-7 on grass
comments.qitaal: 8l C&D win last September (8lb higher today); below form twice since a good reappearance
comments.rathgar: Reliable sort (close 2nd at Epsom latest) and firmly in the mix if he adapts to this track
comments.takeheart: Won a valuable 1m2f handicap at Glorious Goodwood (good) last summer off 3lb lower
comments.wardajamila: Close 4th of six at Epsom (1m2f, good) when outsider of the party was a promising return

races.raceComment: rathgar is marginally preferred with a score of 50.4%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form over wardajamila. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The most striking candidate has to be SPORTINGSILVERMINE, another horse for whom James Owen has worked the oracle.

comments.gisellesdefence: Three wins last May-July (1m2f; twice claimer ridden); 1lb below his last winning mark
comments.lusaka: Out of form for all of 2024 except for when he won at Nottingham (1m6f, good) in August
comments.marhabamillion: Tailed off on final start for Owen Burrows; changed hands for 50,000gns last July; gelded
comments.miaswell: Won twice (1m, soft) last May/July for David O'Meara but modest in four hurdle races since
comments.modelapproach: Fair maiden (0-5) in Ireland; won twice over hurdles but below form in that sphere lately
comments.obsidianknight: 0-11 on turf; however, going well on Lingfield AW recently and now bids for a hat-trick
comments.oman: 9lb higher than when winning a division of this race last year; also scored in October
comments.reelrosie: 2023 win here; mixed for new yard; cheekpieces (absent for over two years) return
comments.shahbaz: Both wins were on AW, including penultimate start; old turf form was better than this mark
comments.smallfry: Has won here; the recent satisfactory return to the Flat may bring him back to his best
comments.sportingsilvermine: 0-18 in Ireland but he's won both his starts (1m3f/1m4f handicaps) for James Owen
comments.thedancingpoet: 6-18 at Catterick, unraced here; well beaten at three other tracks this term
comments.tokyobay: Won Ripon maiden (1m4f, heavy) in April on 2024 return but has lost his form in handicaps
comments.woodstockcity: Third at this meeting last year and back to form to win at Ripon (1m2f) last August

races.raceComment: smallfry is marginally preferred with a score of 48.8%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and superior course form over obsidianknight. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 2 wins from 9 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include strong course form, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Dorney Lake got the better of KODI LION at Doncaster but the tables can be turned today.

comments.akkadianthunder: Suffered a torrid passage at Leicester on his return; 6f on fast ground remains a query
comments.dorneylake: 2-2 for new yard and picked up well to beat Kodi Lion at Doncaster; solid claims
comments.eminency: Infrequent winner but on a lowly mark and his reappearance run is easy enough to forgive
comments.getit: Won last year's Stewards' Cup off a 5lb higher mark; fair form in Bahrain this year
comments.kodilion: Two promising runs for new yard this year; unexposed as a sprinter; course winner; solid
comments.overtheblues: Had excuses at Bath on her stable debut; improvement needed to defy this mark though
comments.photosynthesis: Promising stable debut last month after a long absence; more needed to take this
comments.rohaan: This C&D brings out the best in him; not as good as he was but handicapped accordingly
comments.warmspell: Promising stable debut (7f) in March and could have more to offer back sprinting
comments.woolhampton: Fine record here but she's best at 5f and could prove vulnerable to stronger stayers

races.raceComment: kodilion is marginally preferred with a score of 53.2%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive and more reliable profile over dorneylake. Placed in 4 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 2 wins from 4 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include positive comments and improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Having shaped better than his final position on his Epsom return, THE COFFEE POD is preferred to Reigning Profit.

comments.abate: Well held latest and such an easy 5f wouldn't appeal as optimal; into the veteran stage
comments.betweenthesticks: Stall 2 not ideal for one happiest on the sharp end; Reigning Profit his yard's best shout
comments.birkenhead: Took his Catterick record to 4-8 when making all 16 days ago; needs more upped 4lb
comments.highopinion: Boasts a solid record over C&D but may need some help from the handicapper now
comments.lettuceleaf: Finished last season on a downswing and isn't obviously fancied from the outside stall
comments.profiteer: Well held off a career-high mark on his 6f comeback recently; easy 5f is a bare minimum
comments.reigningprofit: 2lb higher than under the penalty from tomorrow; every chance of making it 2-2 round here
comments.thecoffeepod: Things didn't pan out his way at Epsom; 2lb below his last winning mark; easy 5f is ideal

races.raceComment: reigningprofit is marginally preferred with a score of 56.3%, holding clear edges in better ratings and stronger recent form over profiteer. Won 1 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: The vote goes to THE GOOD BISCUIT who caught the eye on stable debut over C&D last month. Drying ground would be ideal.

comments.beyondborders: Well behind a couple of these on his stable debut/reappearance over C&D last month
comments.fortamour: 6-21 over C&D and his record in this race reads 124; another big run is likely
comments.latearrival: Remains 5lb above his last winning mark so he will need to pull out more
comments.markschoice: Seven course wins, but losing run up to 16 and has been off for five months
comments.mistersox: 2-2 since returning last month; 2lb well in under his penalty, but fast ground a question
comments.rebelempire: Lightly raced on turf; 6f suits him best but this looks a stiff task under top weight
comments.showtimemahomes: Back off last winning mark, but others are that bit more convincing
comments.thegoodbiscuit: Made an eyecatching stable debut when fourth over C&D last month; interesting
comments.truepromise: All four wins have come on the AW and has shown little in four goes on turf
comments.wreckitryley: C&D winner who met trouble when behind Mister Sox at Pontefract last time; could figure
